files: resource/sound/weapon/shot/<path>/ and resource/sound/weapon/reload/<path>/ (*.wav, folder.set); resource/sound/sound.set (loudness classes)

groups.name: What it is and what it copies
Range, speed, reload, rate of fire

vars.where: file name set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon]
vars.plain: The new weapon's own name; the game also reads its tags from the file name split on dots.
vars.tool: gen gun name / gen clone tags

vars.where: folder set/stuff/<class>/
vars.plain: Which family folder the weapon file sits in: cannon, machine gun, rifle, sub-machine gun, pistol, launcher, rocket artillery, flame, bombs, melee, special.
vars.tool: gen gun (gun/ only) / gen clone (same folder as the base)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: root word
vars.plain: What kind of weapon the engine builds: one that fires shells or bullets, a flame thrower, a bomb drop, or a thrower.
vars.tool: gen clone (inherits it)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {from "x"}
vars.plain: The weapon or pattern this one copies; everything not written here comes from it.
vars.tool: gen gun like / gen clone stuff

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {tag "..."}
vars.plain: Words that say what the weapon is (rifle, mgun, smg, pistol, sniper, rocketlauncher, to_hand ...); they pick the soldier's animations, skill and effects.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/tag, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {mass}
vars.plain: How heavy the weapon is.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/mass, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {desc "key"}
vars.plain: Optional text key to use for the name instead of the one made from the tags.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/desc, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {entity "x"}
vars.plain: The 3D model the soldier holds and that lies on the ground: an entity under entity/inventory/.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/entity, op add)

vars.where: entity/inventory/-weapon/<e>/<e>.def
vars.plain: The model's own small file: it includes stuff_small.ext and names the .mdl (Extension).
vars.tool: gen clone (entity + as, copy_assets)

vars.where: entity/inventory/.../<e>.def: {extender "stuff" {item "tags"}}
vars.plain: Ties the model back to the weapon so a dropped model becomes that weapon when picked up.
vars.tool: gen set on the def (path actor/extender/item)

vars.where: entity/inventory/-weapon/<e>/<e>.mdl (+ .ply LODs)
vars.plain: The skeleton and meshes of the hand model (or the barrel model for a mounted gun, which is part of the vehicle model).
vars.tool: Models page (stage, open, check)

vars.where: .mdl bone "foresight<N>"
vars.plain: The muzzle point of the model: shots, flash and the sight start here; the weapon's foresight key names it.
vars.tool: Models page

vars.where: .mdl bone "handle"
vars.plain: The grip point where the soldier's hand holds the weapon.
vars.tool: Models page

vars.where: .mdl bone "fxshell"
vars.plain: The point where empty cases fly out.
vars.tool: Models page

vars.where: .mdl bone "fxshot"
vars.plain: Launchers only: the back end where the back-blast puff comes out.
vars.tool: Models page

vars.where: .mdl {Volume "body"} {Volume "select"}
vars.plain: Boxes around the model used to click on it and to let bullets hit it on the ground.
vars.tool: Models page

vars.where: entity/inventory/-weapon/<e>/*.dds (+ _sp.dds), named in the .mtl
vars.plain: The pictures painted on the model (colour and shine).
vars.tool: /art/copy (game files) or task upload

vars.where: entity/inventory/-weapon/<e>/*.mtl
vars.plain: The material file that says which textures the meshes use.
vars.tool: /art/copy

vars.where: .mdl {Extender "preview" {"Stuff"|"Stuff_primary" {camera ..} {lights ..}}}
vars.plain: The inventory picture is the 3D model drawn live; this block sets the camera and lights of that picture.

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {fillingVisible "prefix"}
vars.plain: Shows the loaded rounds on the model, using bones named prefix01, prefix02 ...
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/fillingVisible, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets or {parameters}: {bullet_view "entity" {tail "e" "bone"}}
vars.plain: The look of the shell while it flies, for this weapon, with an optional trail.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/bullet_view, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {filling "tags" n [max]}
vars.plain: Which ammunition the weapon takes, by its tags (for a cannon the shell family such as bullet75).
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/filling, op add) (gen weapon swaps the family on a vehicle)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {filling "tags" <n>}
vars.plain: How many rounds one load holds (magazine or belt); 1 when left out.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/filling, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {filling "tags" n <max>}
vars.plain: Most rounds a carrier holds for this weapon (rounded to whole loads).
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/filling, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {ammoLocked}
vars.plain: The ammunition cannot be taken out or changed (one-shot launchers).
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/ammoLocked, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {preloaded}
vars.plain: The weapon comes already loaded.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/preloaded, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {calibre}
vars.plain: Bore of the weapon; decides how much thin armour counts against it. Taken from a bulletNN ammo name when left out.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/calibre, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {parameters "ammo tags" {..}}
vars.plain: Own values for one kind of ammunition (range, damage table, speed, spread ...), used when the loaded round carries all these tags.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/parameters, op add) / gen gun pen (apcr follows)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets or {parameters}: {rechargeTime}
vars.plain: Reload time once the magazine is empty (for a cannon: time to the next shell).
vars.tool: gen gun recharge / Balance page Reload s / gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/rechargeTime, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets or {parameters}: {recoveryTime} or ("recoveryTime" r(rounds per minute))
vars.plain: Pause after each shot (bolt or cycle); sets the rate of fire. Presets write it as rounds per minute.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/recoveryTime, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {reloadAnimBonus}
vars.plain: Shortens the soldier's reload animation and its sound.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/reloadAnimBonus, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets or {parameters}: {range effective longest} or ("range_<preset>")
vars.plain: Two distances: where the unit opens fire on its own, and the farthest shot the player can order.
vars.tool: gen gun range (preset) / Units recipe Longer rifle range / gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/range, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets or {parameters}: {aimRange}
vars.plain: Range the damage curve and the computer's aiming use, when the weapon sets it apart from range.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/aimRange, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets or {parameters}: {maxRange}
vars.plain: The absolute farthest a shot can go; no limit when left out.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/maxRange, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets or {parameters}: {speed} or ("speed" s(m/s))
vars.plain: How fast the shell flies. Presets take the real muzzle speed in m/s and halve it.
vars.tool: gen gun speed / gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/speed, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets or {parameters}: {gravity}
vars.plain: How strongly the shell drops in flight (1 = normal, 0 = none).
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/gravity, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {reactive}
vars.plain: Marks a rocket: no gravity, a little wobble, burns out past its range.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/reactive, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {aimType}
vars.plain: How it aims: flat (direct), lobbed like a mortar (curved), or either (adaptive).
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/aimType, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets or {parameters}: {curve "name"}
vars.plain: How the shell's strength falls with distance, by a named curve.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/curve, op add)

vars.where: set/ballistics.set {"name" {x y} ..}
vars.plain: A new energy curve of your own: pairs of distance (share of range) and strength.

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {AimingTolerance}
vars.plain: How far off target the barrel may still point and fire.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/AimingTolerance, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {SpreadTolerance}
vars.plain: The unit waits to fire while moving makes it less accurate than this.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/SpreadTolerance, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {RelaxationTime}
vars.plain: Settling (aim) time after the gun stops turning.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/RelaxationTime, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {LockFireDistanceTime}
vars.plain: Blocks the next shot until this time has passed. No vanilla weapon sets it.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/LockFireDistanceTime, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {ZeroingAccuracy f f ..}
vars.plain: Spread factors for each sight setting after the first (later settings less accurate).
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/ZeroingAccuracy, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {foresight "name"}
vars.plain: Which muzzle bone and sight view the weapon uses.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/foresight, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {automatic}
vars.plain: The weapon fires bursts.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/automatic, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {automatic_ai}
vars.plain: Fires bursts only when the computer controls it.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/automatic_ai, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets or {parameters}: {TraceFreq}
vars.plain: Every how many shots a tracer shows (0 = never).
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/TraceFreq, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {DisableRicochet}
vars.plain: Its shots never bounce off armour.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/DisableRicochet, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {burst {short n dev}} or ("burst_short|medium|long")
vars.plain: Length of a short burst and its random spread.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/burst/short, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {burst {long n dev}}
vars.plain: Length of a long burst and its random spread.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/burst/long, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {burst {min n}}
vars.plain: Fewest rounds fired per trigger pull (rocket salvos, howitzer series).
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/burst/min, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {burst {noaiming}}
vars.plain: Does not re-aim between the rounds of a burst.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/burst/noaiming, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {burst {rangeKoef}}
vars.plain: Share of the range inside which long bursts are used (0.33 when left out).
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/burst/rangeKoef, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets or {parameters}: {spreading <n> ..}
vars.plain: Size of the circle shots land in at full range (first number of the spreading block).
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/spreading, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: ("accuracy_<preset>")
vars.plain: A ready spread table by name (rifle, smg, mgun, sniper_rifle, low, medium, high ...).
vars.tool: gen gun accuracy (cannon presets only)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {spreading {RadiusTable {dist radius} ..}}
vars.plain: Spread radius at each distance; wins over the other spread keys.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/spreading/RadiusTable, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {spreading {SpreadRadius}}
vars.plain: Spread circle at full range when there is no table.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/spreading/SpreadRadius, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {spreading {RadiusFunction x y ..}}
vars.plain: A curve of spread by share of range, multiplied by SpreadRadius.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/spreading/RadiusFunction, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {spreading {SpreadPower}}
vars.plain: Higher values pull more shots to the centre of the circle.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/spreading/SpreadPower, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {spreading {SpreadXYRatio}}
vars.plain: Stretches the circle into an ellipse along the line of fire.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/spreading/SpreadXYRatio, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {spreading {SpreadYadjust}}
vars.plain: Tilts the spread in height.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/spreading/SpreadYadjust, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {spreading {BurstAccuracy % % ..}}
vars.plain: Accuracy of each round in a burst in percent; later rounds spread more (recoil climb).
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/spreading/BurstAccuracy, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {spreading {BurstRecoveryTime}}
vars.plain: Time after a burst until accuracy is back to the first value.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/spreading/BurstRecoveryTime, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {spreading {BurstSpreadCount|Delta|Width}}
vars.plain: Read by the game but used by nothing; changing them does nothing.

vars.where: no weapon key: hand weapons = BurstAccuracy; mounted guns = barrel recoil animation in the vehicle model
vars.plain: There is no recoil number; climb comes from BurstAccuracy and the kick you see is a model animation.
vars.tool: Models page (animation operations) for the barrel kick

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets or {parameters}: {projectileDamage}
vars.plain: Armour piercing at the muzzle when there is no table; also fills the soldier damage when that is missing.
vars.tool: gen gun damage / gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/projectileDamage, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets or {parameters}: {projectileDamageTable {dist pen} ..} or ("damage" a() b() c() d() e())
vars.plain: Armour piercing by distance; the presets take five values for 100, 500, 1000, 1500 and 2000 m.
vars.tool: gen gun pen / pen_scale / gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/projectileDamageTable, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets or {parameters}: {projectileDamageClip}
vars.plain: Cap on the piercing value.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/projectileDamageClip, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets or {parameters}: {projectileDamageThreshold} or ("caliber_<preset>")
vars.plain: How much of a plate the shell must spend to break it (1 or more).
vars.tool: gen gun caliber (preset) / gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/projectileDamageThreshold, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets or {parameters}: {healthDamage}
vars.plain: Damage to soldiers per hit.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/healthDamage, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets or {parameters}: {healthDamageClip}
vars.plain: Cap on the damage to soldiers.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/healthDamageClip, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets or {parameters}: {RicochetDamageClip}
vars.plain: Cap on the damage a bounced shot does. No vanilla weapon sets it.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/RicochetDamageClip, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets or {parameters}: {RicochetEnergyDamping {angle factor} ..}
vars.plain: How much strength a bounced shot keeps, by hit angle.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/RicochetEnergyDamping, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets or {parameters}: {OvermatchDamping {angle factor} ..}
vars.plain: How much a thin plate counts against this shell at each angle.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/OvermatchDamping, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {special {mode}}
vars.plain: The special shot: an aimed shot (aim) or a remote detonation (detonate).
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/special/mode, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {special {PrepareTime}}
vars.plain: How long the soldier aims before the special shot.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/special/PrepareTime, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {special {PrepareCursor}}
vars.plain: Mouse cursor while the special shot is chosen.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/special/PrepareCursor, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {special {accuracy}}
vars.plain: Divides the spread of the special shot.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/special/accuracy, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {special {damage f [dev]}}
vars.plain: Damage factor of the special shot instead of the distance curve.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/special/damage, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {special {throw_off}}
vars.plain: The special shot can knock the target down.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/special/throw_off, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {special {throw_off_always}}
vars.plain: Every shot knocks the target down (shotguns). Not copied by from.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/special/throw_off_always, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {fireSound "path"}
vars.plain: Shot sound: a file or folder under sound/weapon/shot/ (a folder plays a random file each shot).
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/fireSound, op add) (Art page sound view reads it)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {reloadSound "path"}
vars.plain: Reload sound under sound/weapon/reload/.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/reloadSound, op add)

vars.where: sound/weapon/shot/<path>/*.wav (and reload/)
vars.plain: The sound files themselves (one or several variants).
vars.tool: /art/copy (game sounds) or task upload; tools/lib/wav writes PCM16/IMA

vars.where: sound/weapon/shot/<path>/folder.set {loudness "class"}
vars.plain: How far the shot is heard: a loudness class from sound/sound.set.

vars.where: sound folder.set {signal shot <m>}
vars.plain: Radius in which soldiers notice the shot.

vars.where: sound folder.set {volume}
vars.plain: Volume factor for the folder.

vars.where: no key in as64
vars.plain: There is no separate echo or tail sound; the tail is part of the shot wav.

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {states {prepare "state"}}
vars.plain: Stance-machine state used to get the weapon ready.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/states/prepare, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {states {unprepare}}
vars.plain: State used to put the weapon away.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/states/unprepare, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {states {reload}}
vars.plain: Reload animation state.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/states/reload, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {states {unload}}
vars.plain: Unload animation state.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/states/unload, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {states {fire}}
vars.plain: Fire animation state.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/states/fire, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {states {aim}}
vars.plain: Aim animation state.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/states/aim, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {states {can_aim}}
vars.plain: State that tests whether the soldier can aim now.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/states/can_aim, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: {inventory {fsm "x"}}
vars.plain: Which carry and handling set the soldier uses (file set/stuff/_settings/<x>.fsm).
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/inventory/fsm, op add)

vars.where: stuff file set/stuff/<class>/<name>[.weapon] or its pattern/presets: weapon tag (pistol smg rifle mgun rocketlauncher sniper flame_thrower ..)
vars.plain: The class word in the tags picks the soldier's animation set and which skill perk counts; animation names come from the engine.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/tag, op add)

vars.where: set/interaction_entity/human.inc {on "link_weapon"}, picked by weapon tag
vars.plain: Muzzle flash and empty-case effect of a hand weapon, chosen by its class tag (pistol, shotgun, rifle, smg, mgun, flame_thrower).
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/tag, op add)

vars.where: vehicle def {props .. "muzzle_<size>"}

gaps: gen gun writes only cannons in set/stuff/gun/ (recharge, speed, pen, damage, range/accuracy/caliber presets): rifles, MGs, SMGs, pistols, launchers need gen clone + raw set rows -> extend op gun with class (rifle|mgun|smg|pistol|bazooka|reactive|flame) and fields rof (rounds/min -> recoveryTime), burst, spread, health, filling, sounds

rate of fire is written as ("recoveryTime" r(rpm)) and accuracy/burst as presets in non-cannon folders: no op picks those presets -> op gun fields rof and preset names validated against <class>/.presets
per-ammo {parameters "tags"} blocks other than the apcr pen table: no op -> op gun field params: {tags: {range, speed, pen, recharge}}
new sound folder (wavs + folder.set loudness, signal, volume) has no write step -> op sound (name, files, loudness, signal, volume, kind shot|reload) writing resource/sound/weapon/<kind>/<name>/
hand/inventory model of a new weapon: no op clones an inventory entity and re-points {extender "stuff" {item}} -> op stuffmodel (like entity, as, item tags, textures)
inventory picture = {Extender "preview"} camera block in the .mdl: no tool edits it -> op stuffmodel copies the base camera; a camera editor on the Models page later
who carries it: breed inventory lines (item, filled, ammo count, in_hands) only via raw gen breed set -> op kit (breed, item, filled|count, in_hands, ammo)
vehicle ammo box lines (item count, user place) beyond the family swap of gen weapon -> op box (entity, item tags, count, user)
AccuracyByMotion on a mount is a macro ("abm_<preset>"): no op picks it -> gen weapon field abm (preset name)
new energy curve in set/ballistics.set: no op (whole-file override) -> op curve (name, points) appending to a mod copy
recoil: no key; barrel kick is a model animation -> Models page animation hand-off, no gen op
new soldier animations for a new weapon class: engine-chosen names (HUM-30) -> outside-program hand-off only
sound loudness class, signal radius, volume live in folder.set: covered by op sound above
